title: Kunomlilo Entabeni
description: UThuli nabangane bakhe bathanda ukudlala umdlalo othi ”Kunomlilo eNtabeni.“ Kodwa ngelinye ilanga kuba nomlilo wangempela ophendula umlotha zonke izitshalo ezinhle ezisentabeni. Badangele oThuli kanye nabangani bakhe … kuze kube yilapho bebona izimbali ezincane ezibomvu kanye namahlumela aluhlaza okotshani. Ngabe kuyini lokhu?
subjects: Nature and looking after our planet
